title: introduce-prefill-runner-and-econ-calibrator
author: Ethan Moore
description: Motivation: tenant workloads show variable cold-start costs and suboptimal quant profiles across regions. This PR adds a low-risk daemon+controller (Prefill Runner) plus an offline/online calibration service (Econ Calibrator) that uses recent telemetry to generate tenant-specific prefill heuristics and suggested quantization safety bands. The change aims to reduce per-token unit cost for long-tail tenants by improving prefill coverage and safely nudging quant profiles where eval metrics indicate negligible quality impact. High-level changes: 1) controller/operator that schedules per-tenant prefill jobs and exposes a small, authenticated API for trigger control; 2) new econ-calibrator service that ingests compact workload summaries and runs a small simulation to recommend prefill batch sizes and quant-safety thresholds; 3) a CLI tool for operators to preview recommended changes and run canary rollouts; 4) lightweight schema extension for tenant preference objects and a safe fallthrough policy; 5) metrics/tracing and a new smoke test harness. Rollout plan: canary 5 tenants in us-west for 48h, monitor unit_cost, p50/p95 latency, and quality regression flags; automatic rollback if quality regressions >0.5% or latency SLO breaches. Docs: added a short quickstart and a runbook entry. Links: Linear ENG-1289 and ENG-4310 referenced, internal design doc: /docs/design/prefill-runner-econ-calibrator. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for controller and simulator - [x] e2e smoke that runs a canary profile - [x] CLI dry-run mode - [x] docs and runbook - [x] security review scopes and KMS integration notes - [x] load test at 10% production traffic simulated. Notes: this is intentionally conservative on automatic promotion of quant changes (suggest-only primary flow), the operator must opt-in to apply quant recommendations.
